capabilities: : Extracts and stores video titles in notes.
intentEvidence: Obsidian can already embed YouTube with ![](url), but you have to write that syntax yourself and the result is a bare iframe.
problem: Standard Markdown embedding requires manual syntax and results in bare iframes without titles, making notes less informative.
summary: Converts a pasted YouTube URL into an inline video player block, automatically extracting and writing the video title into the note.
